name: Comic World Taiwan
organizer: C.W.T. 台灣同人誌販售會
blurb: Taiwan's long-running doujinshi circle-sales convention, held several times a year in Taipei, with a separate numbered Kaohsiung series by the same organizer.

notes: Found a real official site (comicworld.com.tw) replacing the Facebook URL given in the seed; it lists all editions directly (no JSON-LD). This file covers only the Taipei-city 'CWT' numbered series per RESEARCH.md's multi-city-brand rule: CWT-74 (2026-12-12/13), CWT-75 (2027-02-13/14) and CWT-76 (2027-08-14/15), all at the NTU gymnasium. A separate same-organizer Kaohsiung series ('CWT-K', next is CWT-K52, 2027-02-20/21 at Kaohsiung Exhibition Center North Hall) and a Taichung series (mentioned in the seed note, not shown on the current /Acts/tw schedule) are different cities of the same brand and are left out of this file. No guest program exists (circle/doujinshi sales only, no 'guests' nav item), so guests is 'none' for every edition. No ticket or per-event detail URLs could be confirmed (the site's event links are JS-routed and did not resolve to plain hrefs), so tickets/guestsPage are left blank rather than guessed. Cover uses the CWT-74 event logo (site has no og:image); the two large ADPics banners on the homepage are third-party ads, not CWT key art, so were not used.
